newsitem.title: UK: S&P may still raise Avonmore rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P may still raise Avonmore rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday, it affirmed its CreditWatch positive placement of the BBB corporate credit rating of Avonmore Foods Plc, and the BBB minus perferred stock rating of its guaranteed unit, Avonmore Delaware LP.
The ratings were placed on CreditWatch on April 15, 1997 following its proposed merger offer for Waterford Foods Plc, the agency said in a statement.
"However, Avonmore's initial 281 million Irish pounds primarily share-based offer was not accepted by Waterford's board, which could lead to an increased offer," S&P said.
It added that on May 7, Avonmore announce the acquisition of Beni Foods Ltd, a UK based meat processor for 54 million Irish pounds (about $82 million), payable on a deferred basis between 1997-2001.
"In light of these events, ratings are now more likely to be affirmed at current levels," S&P said.
